raw_segments.text: The gravediggers took up their spades and flung heavy clods of clay in on the coffin.
Mr. Bloom turned away his face.
And if he was alive all the time, Hugh, by jingo, that would be awful.
No, no, he is dead, of course.
They ought to have some law to pierce the heart and make sure or an electric clock or
a telephone in the coffin and some kind of a canvas airhole.
Rather long to keep them in summer.
Just as well to get shot of them as soon as you are sure there's no.
